recipe.rationale: dev perplexity did not improve on earlier iterations in iteration 7 (best measured 19.09 at step 1000 of iteration 2; iteration 7 ended at 22.976): the over-fitted adapter is not carried forward — restart from the registered base at half that iteration's learning rate (5.0e-05), dropout 0.1, weight decay 0.01, early stopping (patience 3) with the best-adapter artefact; language fidelity below 1.0 for kik, kam (0.846, 0.812) → each micro-batch now drawn from one language chosen uniformly, so the small language is not out-voted
